title: Figures 5.3-5.4: Integrated IEC inspection systems for airport luggage and ship containers
description: Two color technical illustrations. 'Figure 5.3. Further Illustration of the Integrated System for Airport Luggage Inspection' shows an 'RC-IEC Series (Neutron/x-ray Generators)' above a conveyor belt with luggage, a detector array, 'Fuzzy Logic Control Unit', computer and '3D Imaging & Alarming' display in side and top views. 'Figure 5.4. Further Illustration of the Integrated System for Ship Container Inspection' shows a crane lifting a container box from a ship past an 'RC-IEC Series (PFNA/TNA, x-ray)' and detector array at a port dock onto a truck.
